## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or architectural enhancement you are proposing.

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented, including domain models or endpoints if applicable.

## Architectural & Security Considerations
- Does this impact the 3-tier boundary (Web/Mobile -> FastAPI -> DB)?
- Does this require schema migration (Alembic / PostgreSQL)?
- Any RBAC (Buyer, Vendor, Admin) permission rules required?

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or benchmarks here.
